scripts.build-prod:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-prod:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-prod
scripts.build-dev:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-dev:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-dev && pnpm run build-types
scripts.buildBinary-prod:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/triciobserver' ]; then rm bin/triciobserver; fi && xcodebuild -project src/swift/triciobserver/triciobserver.xcodeproj -scheme triciobserver -configuration Release -derivedDataPath src/swift/triciobserver/build && cp src/swift/triciobserver/build/Build/Products/Release/triciobserver bin/triciobserver && shasum -a 256 bin/dev/triciobserver > dist/triciobserver.sha256
scripts.buildBinary-dev:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/dev/triciobserver' ]; then rm bin/dev/triciobserver; fi && xcodebuild -project src/swift/triciobserver/triciobserver.xcodeproj -scheme triciobserver -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath src/swift/triciobserver/build  && cp src/swift/triciobserver/build/Build/Products/Debug/triciobserver bin/dev/triciobserver && shasum -a 256 bin/dev/triciobserver > dist/triciobserver.sha256
